wa_prusik_peak_alpine_craggers_delight.descent_text: Since this single pitch tops out at the Stanley-Burgner P1 exit, most parties continue up Stanley-Burgner or rappel back down this pitch on gear.

wa_prusik_peak_sail_away.descent_text: From the top of the route, make two rappels using the neighboring Solid Gold route's anchors, then walk off down the back (north) side.
